member.name: T:Alkami.MicroServices.Transactions.Data.TransactionCategoryClassification
member.summary: A transaction category classification is a institution name for a set of user-created categories to allow the FI to report across custom categories utilizing a standard set of metrics. For instance, users may create their own categories, however, they are required to associate them to a list of classifications provided by the FI. In turn, the FI can then reporting on spending behaviors, etc. based on classifications they have defined, independent of the names or schemas that users have created for their own custom categorization.

member.summary: Gets or sets the bank that owns the transaction category classification

member.name: P:Alkami.MicroServices.Transactions.Data.TransactionCategoryClassification.BillPayCategoryKey
member.summary: Gets or sets the the field will be used to profile the bill pay provider's category identifier for transmittal. If all user-created transaction categories that relate to this transaction category classification also relate to a particular category identifier in the third-party bill pay system, and payments for payees must transmit a category, then this field is applicable.
member.remarks: If, for instance, a bill pay provider must get a category designation "AUTO" for any automobile-related expense, then the financial institution can setup this classification named "Automobile" with the BillPayCategoryKey of "AUTO". When a user then creates their own category called "Gas" and relates it to this "Automobile" classification, and subsequently sends a payment to Shell Oil which has a default expense category of "Gas", then through this field, the system will be able to properly send "AUTO" for the user's payment.
